title: Missing Documentation Section: "Use Advanced Git Workflows"
body:
There is currently a discrepancy in the Claude Code documentation. The table of contents includes a link to [Use advanced git workflows](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/agents-and-tools/claude-code/tutorials#use-advanced-git-workflows), but this section does not exist on the actual page.

This inconsistency creates confusion for readers who click the link expecting to find information about advanced git workflows with Claude Code but instead find nothing related to the topic.

## Proposed Solution

Either:

- Remove the link from the table of contents if this content is not planned for the near future, or
- Add the missing section to the page with appropriate content about advanced git workflows
author: momr
